messages:
Nora Patel: quick heads-up — planning to pin Goldrush model to v2 in the catalog at 10:30 PT today. Intention is 5% canary for 30m, then promote if no regressions. Who can do smoke + rollback readiness?
Samir Khan: I can do preflight at 10:15 (run through smoke checklist). Is the config PR merged?
Jin Park: PR merged and CI green. Telemetry hooks + eval set uploaded to staging.
Marco Rossi: I'll own the rollback path and watch the latency + error dashboards. I can also temp-disable routing if something flares.
Nora Patel: awesome — can someone confirm the canary policy in the pin config? would rather be explicit.
Jin Park: config snippet: ```json
{"model": "goldrush", "version": "v2", "strategy": "canary", "percent": 5, "duration": "30m", "fallback": "goldrush:v1"}
```
Samir Khan: looks good. checklist for deploy: 1) infra smoke run 2) traffic routed to canary 3) perf & quality gates passing 4) rollback tested (dry-run)
infra-bot: deploy-bot created scheduled job deploy-5532 for 2024-06-15T17:30:00Z (window 1h). Logs channel: #deploy-5532.
Marco Rossi: I will run a dry-run rollback now (no traffic). pinging results in 2m.
Marco Rossi: dry-run rollback succeeded — script exits 0, restored routing keys locally, no DB schema touches.
Samir Khan: preflight smoke (simple prompt set) running on staging now — will post results in 5.
Samir Khan: preflight smoke: 12/12 prompts ok, latencies within baseline, one low-quality reply for prompt #7 but within expected variance.
Nora Patel: perfect. I'll start the canary at 10:30. I'll post updates and the first 5 traces here. Marco, Samir — if you don't see a green within 15m flag it and we'll roll back.
Marco Rossi: watching dashboards. alert rules set to 3x error rate or +20% p50.
Jin Park: QA: will monitor evaluation set and surface any semantic regressions. I've added a short eval that runs at 5m intervals.
Nora Patel: thanks — launching now. will update in-thread when canary reaches 5% and again at 30m. :rocket: 
Nora Patel: canary reached 5% and serving. first 10 requests look good. posting traces: https://internal/traces/deploy-5532
Samir Khan: seeing stable p50, no error spike. LGTM from smoke side.
Marco Rossi: rollback not needed. metrics stable. promoting to 100% in 10m?
Nora Patel: let's wait full 30m as planned, then promote. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
